methods.name: inspectContent
methods.description: Finds potentially sensitive info in content.

methods.name: redactImage
methods.description: Redacts potentially sensitive info from an image.

methods.name: deidentifyContent
methods.description: De-identifies potentially sensitive info from a ContentItem.

methods.name: reidentifyContent
methods.description: Re-identifies content that has been de-identified.

params.name: parent
params.description:
Required. Parent resource name.

The format of this value varies depending on whether you have specified a processing location:

  • Projects scope, location specified:
    projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION_ID
  • Projects scope, no location specified (defaults to global):
    projects/PROJECT_ID

The following example parent string specifies a parent project with the identifier example-project, and specifies the europe-west3 location for processing data:

parent=projects/example-project/locations/europe-west3

methods.name: listInfoTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of the sensitive information types that the DLP API supports. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/infotypes-reference to learn more.

params.name: name

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The name of the DlpJob resource to be cancelled.
